correctness.rationale: Theorem A (w_l in J^{(2)}\J^2 for all l): verified. Tau formula 4+floor((l-1)/2) proved by disjoint triangle-plus-path lower bound and sharp C* construction; auditor checked construction covers all edges and counts correctly. Edge-sums of w_l all =2, deg=l+5 < 2*tau (gap 1 for even l, 2 for odd l) excludes J^2 membership since every J^2 monomial has degree >=2*tau. Machine tau brute force l<=12 matches formula; verify_handproof.py re-ran OK for l=1..12. Theorem B (sdefect(D1)=5 exactly): Lemma C ({0,1,2}^n completeness by decrement) and Lemma E (sdefect = #minimal 2-covers outside J^2 via antichain/divisibility, restricting pair-sums to minimal covers justified) are correct. Auditor independently brute-forced {0,1,2}^6: exactly 15 minimal 2-covers matching D1_min2_table.json; 10 have explicit minimal-cover pair-sum witnesses (each verified to equal the named cover sum and lie below the monomial), 5 gaps have no pair-sum below (verified over all 31 pair-sums). Slot-counting hand proofs for m1..m4 (zero forces two vertices in both covers, >=4 slots needed on (1,1,1) side allowing <=3) checked valid; w by degree gap. Theorem C (>=5 at every l): five patterns are 2-covers (all adjacent sums >=2 since values in {1,2}), minimal (single-decrement analysis checked case-by-case; auditor confirmed the M3/M4 interior-corner logic and endpoint logic; machine minimality+outside-J^2 re-verified l<=12 ALL OK), outside J^2 (same slot argument valid at every l; M_i have zeros so never multiples of all-ones w_l). Exact census 5,7,13,20,29,47,70,110,171,263,411,634 for l=1..12: auditor re-executed sdefect_census.py from scratch and reproduced all 12 values identically; independent all-covers code path matches for l=1..5 (CROSS_CHECK PASS); auditor's own brute force matches to l=8 (47 at l=6, 70 at l=7, 110 at l=8). Pruning in census is safe (prunes only already-violated edges). Exponential-growth remark is explicitly limited to verified l<=9 subfamily and excluded from the headline; limitations honestly state no closed formula is claimed. Characteristic-free (monomial throughout). Headline (A)+(B)+(C-bound+census) is proved, with computation honestly labeled where used.

The headline is an exact invariant of a specific natural object motivated before computation: D1 is the smallest bicyclic that is not a vertex clique-sum (two odd holes interacting across a bridge), and symbolic-vs-ordinary powers of cover ideals with resurgence/sdefect is a recognized frontier since Herzog-Hibi-Trung (2006). The value was not known or mechanically implied: admission triage and independent retrieval found no dumbbell cover-defect result, and the admitted target itself asserted the false defect-1. A future researcher needs the precise fact (which monomials generate J(D1)^{(2)} over J(D1)^2 and why defect-1 fails uniformly). Not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny unmotivated gain, or unexplained enumeration: generators are proved minimal with hand slot-counting proofs and structural interpretation; the l<=12 census is honestly labeled finite (no closed formula claimed) and does not erase the exact D1 headline per the incomplete-census rule. Independently worth retrieving. PASSES.
